fields.v: Model-mediated feedback loops for AI-generated software (no name or version): software models recovered post hoc from generated code, used in an agentic loop (automated checking and repair) and a human reflective loop (inspection and revision of assumptions)

Recovered software models (Table 1): domain and data model, behavioural model, architectural model, constraint model, runtime model; linked to code, tests, traces and prompts with evidence and confidence markers; derived regression tests, static checks, repair prompts, model edits

Human intent/prompts -> agent generates system -> recover models from code -> symbolic checks (model checking, analysis, tests, policy checks) -> refinement (repair prompts, model edits) -> recovery and checking repeat; human reflective loop in parallel. Runs at natural pauses: before deployment, after agentic change, on test failure, when a prototype gains users, during review
